objective: Perform the first manual append-only archive of terminal coordination history while preserving current live work and durable relative links.
non_goals: No deletion or rewriting of archived evidence
No movement or rewriting of immutable handoff packet roots
No archival of active, blocked, assigned, queued, awaiting-verification, prerequisite, or dependent work
No rules, UI, probe, implementation, product, or workflow-authority change
required_evidence: Fresh physical-line and byte counts proving the documented trigger
Current-root packet validator exit 0 before movement
Append-only archive file and compact repository-relative live links
Separate Test Automation safety verification after movement
